about: tests/engine_first_view_parity.mjs is civicsample-engine's scripts/first_view_parity.mjs, byte for byte, at the commit below (engine main after PR #24 merged, the gate that stubs every other top-level app.js function, records the calls and flips their answers; the script is the same as at #24's head, 2aaef5f): the check the engine's weekly publish runs on this site's app.js and index.html, over the staged data parts, before it publishes a firstView block. tests/first_view.test.mjs runs it on this checkout and reads its stub document and runtime from it.
